description: List deleted repositories you can restore or purge: your personal ones and those of organizations you own (a site admin may pass all: true for the whole instance). Each has its id, full_name and restorable_until — after that date it is purged automatically. Read-only. Needs 'repo' scope. Returns {total_count, repositories:[{id, full_name, private, deleted_at, deleted_by, restorable_until}]}.

all.description: Site admins only: every deleted repository on the instance

name: gluecron_list_deleted_repos
